messages:
camille: Quick thread — prepping the benchmark launch post + webinar. Draft thought: lead with a short narrative: 'How we cut per-token cost by 3x while keeping tail latency < 120ms' and follow with 2 charts (latency distribution, tokens->$). Need: snappy post headline, 3 slide storyboard ideas, chart specs, and inbound routing rules for demo requests. Thoughts?
ray: love the headline direction. prefer '3x cost, same quality' vs 'cut' — less aggressive. also can we avoid absolute ms claim in headline? maybe keep the 120ms in subhead.
camille: good call. headline candidate: "3x lower serving cost, without trading latency or quality". subhead: "Real-world slices: p50/p95/p99 and token economics for common prompts".
morgan: for slides — 1) one-liner + topology (how caching/batching works), 2) two-panel chart: left latency CDF p50/p95/p99 across models, right tokens->$ waterfall, 3) CTA + experiment results (A/B on quality checks).
tara: chart specs: latency CDF = sample of 100k infer requests over 7d, bins 5ms, annotate p50/p95/p99. tokens->$ waterfall: raw model cost, batching savings, cache delta, net effective cost per 1k tokens. can we add a tiny table for expected cost at 1k/10k/100k users?
ray: for copy variants — Variant A (data-first): "Measured on production workloads — here's the economic case." Variant B (product-first): "Build faster, ship smarter: lower unit economics for your LLM features." run headline A/B in the launch post.
camille: inbound routing: propose rule set — demo form tag = 'benchmark' -> lead score +1; if ARR estimate > $250k or company size > 500 -> route to AE queue; else -> SDR nurture with webinar invite. Also any 'urgent' demo requests go to on-call AE channel.
morgan: add webinar segmentation: 30-min technical deep-dive (eng-focused) + 20-min customer story (PM/sales-focused). Registration path asks for workload type (chat/generation/embeddings) to auto-attach to lead.
tara: quick ask for visuals team: exportable chart JSON we can hand to design. sample payload: ```csv
metric,model,p50,p95,p99,cost_per_1k
chat-xl,redwood-v1,38,82,210,2.40
embed-large,open-embed,12,30,65,0.90
``` please mock realistic axis labels and a callout on p99 tail.
ops-bot: deployed benchmark page at https://redwood.internal/bench-draft, 4945678000-branch. permission: marketing + design.
camille: perfect. next steps: morgan to draft 3 slide storyboard by EOD Wed, tara to give chart PNGs + CSV, ray to set up A/B test for headline, I'll map inbound routing rules with sales. tagging folks: @morgan @tara @ray — please confirm. :thumbsup:
